ModMetaData.name: Autonomous Colonists (Experimental)
ModMetaData.author: Community prototype
ModMetaData.description: Autonomous Director v0.5 experimental for RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10). Opt-in automatic jobs: eating permitted food, resting in beds, tending/self-tending with player permission, medical rest, native apparel upgrades, safe rescue, fleeing and extinguishing self. Balanced profile default. Observation and execution switches remain separate; upgrades never silently enable jobs. Preserves v0.3 work priorities, specialists, backups, zero priorities, manual locks, exclusions and v0.2 adapter. Never changes player schedules, policies, allowed areas, drafting or weapons. No autonomous armed defense. Compiled against private 1.7 libraries; actual game and Android validation pending. Read INSTALAR.md and AUTONOMIA_0.5.md.
